name: D-allothreonine to L-methionine
summary: A 7-step route from D-allothreonine zwitterion to L-methionine, ingested from Rhea. Every step is curated by Rhea and independently verified here to balance in mass and charge.

reactions.name: aldehyde dehydrogenase (NADP(+))
reactions.equation: acetaldehyde + NADP(+) + H2O = acetate + NADPH + 2 H(+)

reactions.name: 27S pre-rRNA (guanosine(2922)-2'-O)-methyltransferase
reactions.equation: guanosine(2922) in 27S pre-rRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 2'-O-methylguanosine(2922) in 27S pre-rRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H(+)

reactions.name: 21S rRNA (uridine(2791)-2'-O)-methyltransferase
reactions.equation: uridine(2791) in 21S rRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 2'-O-methyluridine(2791) in 21S rRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H(+)

reactions.name: 16S rRNA (guanine(527)-N(7))-methyltransferase
reactions.equation: guanosine(527) in 16S rRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = N(7)-methylguanosine(527) in 16S rRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine

reactions.name: 16S rRNA (guanine(1207)-N(2))-methyltransferase
reactions.equation: guanosine(1207) in 16S rRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = N(2)-methylguanosine(1207) in 16S rRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H(+)
